item.title: Kimi K3 is now available in Devin
item.description: Kimi K3 is now live in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. Optimized for long horizon agentic coding tasks, it approaches frontier-level performance on FrontierCode 1.1 — surpassing GPT-5.5 and behind only Opus, Fable, and GPT-5.6 Sol — with particular strength on debugging.

item.title: Claude Opus 5 is now available in Devin
item.description: Claude Opus 5 is now live in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, and will be part of Devin Cloud’s mode mix. On FrontierCode 1.1, it approaches Fable-level performance at half the cost, with particular strength on difficult debugging and root-cause analysis tasks.

item.title: GPT-5.6 models are now available in Devin
item.description: GPT-5.6 models are now live in Devin. These models stand out for combining top-tier coding-agent performance with very strong token/cost efficiency.
